items.exampleEn: Rice is cultivated in the south of the country.
items.exampleZh: 這個國家的南部種植稻米。

items.exampleEn: She injected some fun into the boring meeting.
items.exampleZh: 她為無聊的會議注入了一些樂趣。

items.exampleEn: Plastic is often used as a substitute for glass.
items.exampleZh: 塑膠常被用來代替玻璃。

items.exampleEn: The little girl gave a happy hop when she saw her dad.
items.exampleZh: 小女孩看到爸爸時開心地跳了一下。

items.exampleEn: Her attachment to her old toy rabbit made her parents smile.
items.exampleZh: 她對舊玩具兔子的依戀讓爸媽笑了。

items.exampleEn: He was praised for his brave deeds.
items.exampleZh: 他因為勇敢的行為受到稱讚。

items.exampleEn: She came to the meeting well prepared.
items.exampleZh: 她來開會前做了充分的準備。

items.exampleEn: My brother can imitate our teacher's voice.
items.exampleZh: 我的兄弟會模仿我們老師的聲音。

items.audioEn: We don't have butter, so let's use oil as a substitute in the cake.
items.audioZh: 我們沒有奶油，蛋糕裡就用油來代替吧。
items.questionZh: 他們要用什麼代替奶油？

items.sentenceEn: It takes time to cultivate good habits.
The cook injected some sauce into the meat.
items.sentenceZh: 廚師把一些醬汁注入肉裡。

items.stemEn: Our school tries to ____ students' interest in science.
items.stemZh: 我們學校努力培養學生對科學的興趣。

items.stemEn: Are you ____ for tomorrow's big game?
items.stemZh: 你準備好明天的大賽了嗎？

items.passageEn: My grandfather has a small farm in the hills, where he cultivates vegetables and fruit. He has a strong attachment to the farm because his father worked there, too. Last summer, I stayed with him. Every morning, a little bird came to the window and moved toward us with a small hop. Grandpa taught me to imitate its song. One day, Grandpa showed me how to inject liquid plant food into the ground around the young trees. When Grandpa's farm worker was sick, I worked as his substitute for a week. I wasn't prepared for such hard work, but Grandpa said that helping others is a good deed. He thanked me with real gratitude.
items.passageZh: 我爺爺在山上有一座小農場，種植蔬菜和水果。他非常依戀這座農場，因為他的父親以前也在這裡工作。去年夏天，我和他住在一起。每天早上，都有一隻小鳥來到窗前，輕輕一跳朝我們靠近。爺爺教我模仿牠的歌聲。有一天，爺爺教我怎麼把液肥注入小樹周圍的土裡。爺爺的農場工人生病時，我代替他工作了一個星期。我還沒準備好做這麼辛苦的工作，但爺爺說幫助別人是好的行為。他滿懷感激地向我道謝。

questions.questionZh: 爺爺為什麼很依戀這座農場？
options: 他在那裡認識了奶奶，還一起住了很久
他的父親以前也在那裡工作
那裡的蔬菜和水果比城市裡的好吃

questions.questionZh: 作者在農場代替誰工作？

items.promptZh: 我們今天有一位代課老師。
referenceEn: We have a substitute teacher today.
Today we have a substitute teacher.
rubricZh: substitute 表示「代替者」，例如 a substitute teacher 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.promptZh: 這家店的設計仿效了日本的老房子。
referenceEn: The design of this shop imitates old Japanese houses.
This shop's design imitates the style of old Japanese houses.
rubricZh: 用 imitate 表示「仿效」（例如 imitates old Japanese houses；寫 copies 也正確）
